name: Xoi chien phong
summary: Xôi chiên phồng is sticky rice fried until it puffs. The Tiền Giang provincial portal says the rice is cooked, pounded with garlic, cooled, and turned in a pan of boiling oil until it is round and taut like a ball.
origin: Tiền Giang, on the provincial portal, 5 Jan 2019. The portal does not name a Mỹ Tho street.
texture: The provincial portal says the fried rice puffs taut, like a ball.
howToEat: The portal says the fry takes strength and speed. The cook turns the rice continuously in a large pan of boiling oil and works it round until it puffs taut like a ball.
The provincial portal says it is usually eaten with roasted chicken or gà xối mỡ.
